## PostgreSQL

A workspace-local PostgreSQL instance is included — no system service, no
Docker. Data lives under `~/rsm-msba/.rsm-msba/postgres`.

```bash
rsm-pg-start                       # start (initializes on first run)
rsm-pg-psql                        # open psql on the rsm-msba database
rsm-pg-psql -c "SELECT version();" # run one statement
rsm-pgweb                          # browse at http://127.0.0.1:8282
rsm-pg-status                      # is it running?
rsm-pg-stop                        # stop it
```

Connection details: host = socket under `.rsm-msba/postgres/socket` (or
`127.0.0.1`), port = **`$PGPORT`** (run `echo $PGPORT`), databases = `rsm-msba`
and your username. On your own machine the port is stable; on a shared server it
is derived per-user (so students don't collide on one port) — always read it from
`$PGPORT` rather than hard-coding `8765`.
